title: Music Industry Simulator Game: Need Testers
author: Friendly_Fault_9753
selftext:
After over a yar of development(vibe), I’ve finally reached a point where my music industry simulator, Hits Inc., is playable from start to finish.

The game gives you full control over your career and label. You can:
- Record and release music and climb the charts.
- Sign various types of deals, including record, management, endorsement, and sync deals.
- Start your own independent label and sign your own artists.
- Grind on social media to build up your fanbase.

It’s been a long journey to get this playable, and now I need a crew of dedicated testers to help me break it, find those weird bugs, and give me honest feedback on what’s fun and what needs work.

replies.author: Friendly_Fault_9753
replies.body: Thanks for the input. I'll try and get a professional to assist with that.

replies.author: Tommyruin
replies.body: Depending on what style you go for, try to get it consistent. Find an example of a game you like that you could use and get chatgpt or Gemini to mock up some art for the game. Then use that as input and generate other assets

replies.author: Friendly_Fault_9753
replies.body: Great! I really appreciate the top. I'm definitely going to do that.

comments.author: Smilysis
comments.body:
After playing it for a while, here are my thoughts:

\- Very interesting concept, but the UI has way too much clutter and you can get lost very easily  
\- You're forced to confirm performances and play mini games. This is an idle game and it's not really engaging when i have to keep constantly alt tabbing to see if i have a gig to do. If i miss it i get punished. Remove the mini game and make your character automatically play it (the mini game it self is boring too so wathever)  
\- To complement my first point, there's just way too much stuff you can do and honestly, it gets a bit exausting. I highly suggest introducing features slowly instead of giving the players 1 millions options and paths with no tutorials.  
\- As another comment mentioned, i really miss graphics here, the ui is great but image would really make it more immersive and enjoyable.

replies.author: Friendly_Fault_9753
replies.body:
Thank you so much for taking the time to write this out. This is incredibly detailed and exactly the kind of direct feedback I needed to hear.

I'm definitely going to rework that, likely automating the performances based on artist stats or gating manual play behind an early-game phase before you can hire a manager to handle it. 

I really appreciate you playing long enough to spot these structural issues. It’s going to make the game a lot tighter. Thanks again!
